name: Syracuse (Italy)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Syracuse (a yellow eagle on blue) within branches, with S.P.Q.S. on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Syracuse, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Syracuse arms — yellow eagle on blue, crowned, within branches, with scroll S.P.Q.S.
